sections.title: New York Insurance Regulatory Compliance
sections.description: ClickMasters designs NY insurance AI with full awareness of New York's distinctive regulatory framework.

items.title: NY DFS Circular Letter 1 (2019) & AI Guidance
items.description: New York's DFS has issued specific guidance on AI in insurance — requiring fairness testing for underwriting AI, documentation of AI decision factors, and prohibiting use of protected characteristics as proxies in insurance AI. ClickMasters designs NY insurance AI with DFS Circular Letter 1 requirements: disparate impact testing across protected classes defined under NY Human Rights Law, documentation of AI decision factors for DFS examination, and proxy variable screening for race, religion, national origin, and other NY-prohibited characteristics.
items.label: Fairness testing

items.title: NY No-Fault Insurance (PIP)
items.description: New York's comprehensive no-fault auto insurance system creates specific fraud detection requirements and claims processing automation opportunities distinct from most other state insurance markets. NYC's no-fault auto fraud patterns — specific Brooklyn and Queens medical mill networks, staged accidents on specific highway corridors, organized PIP fraud rings — are explicitly incorporated in ClickMasters' NY auto insurance fraud detection model design.
items.label: No-fault fraud

items.title: NYDFS Cybersecurity (Part 500)
items.description: Insurance companies regulated by NY DFS face Part 500 cybersecurity requirements that affect AI system vendor relationships and data security architecture. ClickMasters designs NY insurance AI within NYDFS Part 500 cybersecurity constraints and recommends qualified NY DFS cybersecurity counsel for definitive compliance determinations.
items.label: Cybersecurity
